mapper.insert: insert into roam_stamp (member_id, pic_url, caption, kind, geohash7, lat, lng, city_code, check_state, check_trace, idem_key, del_flag, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{picUrl}, #{caption}, #{kind}, #{geohash7}, #{lat}, #{lng}, #{cityCode}, #{checkState}, #{checkTrace}, #{idemKey}, #{delFlag}, now())
mapper.select: select id, member_id, pic_url, caption, kind, geohash7, lat, lng, city_code, check_state, check_trace, del_flag, create_time from roam_stamp where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0 and check_state != 2 order by create_time desc, id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from roam_stamp where member_id = #{memberId} and del_flag = 0 and check_state != 2

select id, member_id, pic_url, caption, kind, geohash7, lat, lng, city_code, check_state, check_trace, idem_key, del_flag, create_time from roam_stamp where member_id = #{memberId} and idem_key = #{idemKey}
mapper.update: update roam_stamp set check_trace = #{checkTrace} where id = #{id}
update roam_stamp set check_state = 1 where id = #{id} and check_state = 0
update roam_stamp set check_state = 2 where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select s.id from roam_stamp s where s.member_id <> #{memberId} and s.del_flag = 0 and s.check_state = 1 and not exists ( select 1 from roam_stamp_exchange e where e.member_id = #{memberId} and e.received_stamp_id = s.id ) order by s.create_time desc, s.id desc limit #{limit}
mapper.insert: insert into roam_stamp_exchange (member_id, given_stamp_id, received_stamp_id, create_time) values (#{memberId}, #{givenStampId}, #{receivedStampId}, now())
mapper.select: select s.id, s.member_id, s.pic_url, s.caption, s.kind, s.geohash7, s.lat, s.lng, s.city_code, s.check_state, s.del_flag, s.create_time from roam_stamp_exchange e join roam_stamp s on s.id = e.received_stamp_id where e.member_id = #{memberId} and s.del_flag = 0 and s.check_state != 2 order by e.create_time desc, e.id desc limit #{offset}, #{limit}
select count(*) from roam_stamp_exchange e join roam_stamp s on s.id = e.received_stamp_id where e.member_id = #{memberId} and s.del_flag = 0 and s.check_state != 2
